changelog.summary: Bounded source discovery for very large WordPress sites. The wizard defaults to Quick scan: one bounded content page (max 100 items) plus only the taxonomy terms and media dependencies those items reference, never the whole media library or all history. Full site inventory is an explicit, acknowledged choice and remains resumable at term/asset/content page boundaries. Continue no longer starts a scan automatically; it shows the mode, item limit, filters and worst-case page count first. Adds separate Pause/Resume/Cancel, a single-flight guard, startup reconciliation of stale running checkpoints, real progress counters (mode, items scanned/requested, API pages, media dependencies, referenced terms, bytes) and a NASA-scale 36k-post/250k-media fixture proving a three-post scan stays within ten requests. See docs/migration-studio/BOUNDED-SOURCE-SCANS.md.

desktop.changelog: Desktop 0.8.0-alpha.13: bounded source scans. Quick scan is the recommended default and fetches one bounded content page plus referenced taxonomy/media dependencies only; Full site inventory requires an explicit acknowledgement and shows its worst-case page count. Continue cannot start an unbounded crawl. Pause and Cancel are separate controls during a run; Resume is offered for interrupted checkpoints. Progress reports real counters and distinguishes scan scope from total available source content. Also fixes stale running checkpoints being offered for resume after restart. Rebuilt with CMS 0.8.0-alpha.8 and Publisher 0.8.0-alpha.2.

publisher.changelog: Unchanged in this release; the Publisher artifact is byte-identical to 0.8.0-alpha.2.

cms.changelog: CMS 0.8.0-alpha.8: optional featured images with existing-QDN selection, device upload, preview, replace, remove and deterministic first-suitable-body-image fallback; explicit WordPress featured images preserved; persistence in the native index, qms-qdn-content@1 media.featured and the edit overlay; reuse by content hash; rendering on home cards, lists, detail and search; fee quote includes a new image resource. Adds visible template version and stale-deployment guidance, refuses an untouched one-character automatic slug from a longer title while preserving legitimate short and manual slugs, and fixes media-map array normalization. Includes all CMS 0.8.0-alpha.7/6/5 fixes. See docs/migration-studio/CMS-EDITING-AND-SLUGS.md.
